overview: Takaya combines three residential towers, Kalina and Melody townhouses, and Kaia villas. Planned home counts do not confirm availability.
research.locationNote: Motor City, beside Dubai Autodrome. Confirm the selected home’s orientation and outlook on its approved plan.
research.priceNote: The developer’s project body and microsite advertise AED 850,000; its main-page header shows AED 2,796,000. Obtain a dated quotation for a specific available home.
research.paymentNote: Historical non-studio launch reference below: 60% during construction and 40% over three years after handover. The presentation excludes studios: their 40% falls on completion. Confirm current terms.
research.handoverNote: The developer targets Q4 2027. This remains a forecast, not confirmation of completion or possession.
